title: Molly and the Firefighter in the Big Boots
synopsis: Molly meets Captain Ann again as the fox firefighter puts on protective gear, and discovers that the familiar person is still inside the very big coat and boots.
continuity_state: Before: The open day continues. The engine and ladder truck demonstrations are complete; the vehicles and long ladder have been secured. Molly arrived with Farmer Ruth and knows Captain Ann from the greeting at the visitor path. After: Molly, Rex and their friends have seen a calm demonstration of turnout boots, coat, helmet and gloves. The equipment is returned to its designated rack. Molly recognizes Captain Ann regardless of her protective clothes; no emergency or scary event is introduced.

related_resources.reason: Supports specific factual descriptions, not story outcome claims.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: "These boots, trousers, coat, gloves, and helmet help protect us while we work," Captain Ann said.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: Firefighter turnout protective clothing includes boots, protective trousers, coat, gloves and helmet.
